description.p: Exam Pool is an offline-first study app for US amateur radio license exams. It includes the current Technician, General, and Amateur Extra question pools.
Study mode gives immediate feedback and schedules missed questions for later in the session. Practice tests use the official exam structure and show results only after submission.
Question content comes from the NCVEC Question Pool Committee. The app shows official FCC rule citations when they are present, but does not add explanations.
Fix the question metadata layout overflow and improve narrow-window layout.
Initial development release with Technician, General, and Extra pools.
